summary: Phase 2 implementation has critical compilation errors preventing build. While architecture is sound and FM synthesis source is credible, the codebase fails TypeScript compilation, all audio tests are mock-based (not real Web Audio), visual regression evidence is missing, and browser testing is impossible. Hard gates architecturally present but not demonstrated to work. Phase 2 status: INCOMPLETE with major blockers.

issues.title: TypeScript compilation fails
issues.description: pnpm build exits with code 1 due to 7 TypeScript errors in App.tsx and inputHandler.ts. App cannot be built or tested.
fileLocations: src/audio/inputHandler.ts:264,45 - Property 'values' does not exist on type 'MIDIInputMap'
issues.impact: Application is not deployable. No browser testing possible. Hard gates 2-3 unverifiable.

issues.title: No real Web Audio tests
issues.description: All 28 phase 2 audio tests are mock-based unit tests of business logic. None cross the Web Audio boundary per TESTING.md requirement. audio-integration.test.mjs explicitly states 'In actual browser tests, we would validate Tone.js PolySynth output' — implying current tests do NOT.
issues.impact: Hard Gate 3 (controls alter audible output) is undemonstrated. Cannot verify FM synthesis produces sound or that controls affect output.

issues.title: Phase 2 visual regression unchecked
issues.description: Missing required screenshots: evidence/stage2-desktop.png, evidence/stage2-narrow.png, evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md. Cannot confirm Phase 1 → Phase 2 regression status.
issues.impact: Visual regression dimension scores 2/4. Cannot award higher score without comparison evidence.

issues.title: InputHandler not connected to Keyboard
issues.description: InputHandler is created in App.tsx but not passed to Keyboard component. Keyboard.tsx does not accept inputHandler prop. Pointer/touch/keyboard inputs cannot trigger audio.
fileLocations: src/App.tsx:143 - attempts to pass inputHandler to Keyboard
src/components/Keyboard.tsx:5 - interface KeyboardProps does not include inputHandler
issues.impact: Interactive input features are non-functional even if app builds.

issues.title: MIDI types incorrect
issues.description: MIDIInputMap does not have .values() method in DOM typings. WebMidi namespace not properly declared. Code assumes iteration methods not available on actual type.
issues.impact: Cannot iterate MIDI inputs. Runtime error would occur if code executed.

issues.title: Inaccurate completion claims
issues.description: PHASE2_COMPLETION.md claims 'pnpm build ... Success' and 'All hard gates met'. Contradicted by build failure and unverified gates 2-3.
issues.impact: Evaluator cannot trust self-authored assessment documents.

issues.title: Mock-based tests create false positive
issues.description: 38 tests pass, but 28 are shallow mocks that test business logic without Web Audio. Tests do not prove audio functionality.
issues.impact: Cannot trust test suite as evidence of audio implementation.
